title: audit-report
description: Frontmatter of an audit report in DEC-441's form, as the owner accepted it (DEC-446): `milestone`, `commit` (the audited commit) and `pack_sha256` (the hash of the context pack the auditor received). The form has no `type` key and no shared frontmatter, so the schema stands alone: core-schema gives this type to a record in the audit-report folder, `docs/audit/` (DEC-626), that states no `type`. Whether the commit resolves, the table is well-formed and the hash is the pack's is the audit-report validator's (DEC-441), not this schema's.
